post.summary: Publish a post now, or schedule it, on one or more social accounts.
post.description:
Permission: Publish or schedule (`publish`) in the workspace.
Creates a one-off post on the social accounts in `id` and publishes it immediately or at `schedule_date_time`. One call makes one post with one entry per account; the response carries the encrypted post id you poll with `/api/post_status`.
The post is built once and saved as one tab per network (Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Google Business, Pinterest, YouTube, TikTok, Threads, Bluesky) from the same fields, so you can send every network option in one call and each account picks up its own. `message`, `image_url`, `video_url` and `url` are the shared content; `fb_`, `tw_`, `ln_`, `in_`, `gmb_` / `gbp_`, `pi_`, `yt_`, `tk_`, `th_` and `bs_` prefixed fields override the text or add options for one network, and `<prefix>_image_url` / `<prefix>_video_url` give one network media of its own.
The post type follows the media: text only, link (a `url` or a link in the text, with a fetched preview), image (up to 20), video (mp4 or mov), or mixed when both images and a video are given. Every media URL is downloaded by RecurPost's servers, so it must be publicly reachable; a URL already in the workspace owner's RecurPost storage (for example from `/api/media_list`) skips that download.
The checks run in this order: the account ids, `message`, the schedule time, `yt_playlists`, the owner's one-off post limit (403), the media and option checks (400), the plan's video rule (403), then the media is downloaded and stored (400 / 415 / 422) and the post saved; the app's content validator answers 422 with per-network details.
This is one of the Zapier-era endpoints: besides a Bearer token it takes `emailid` + `api_key` in the body (errors then come back as HTTP 200 with the status in the body) or as a Basic header.

Post now vs scheduled: Without `schedule_date_time` the post is handed to the publisher right away. With it, each account's row is stored at the time worked out for that account, and `/api/post_status` shows it in the account's timezone.

Media is fetched synchronously: Images, videos, covers and LinkedIn documents are downloaded and stored during the call; a large video makes the request take as long as the download. Hosts behind authentication, private addresses and expiring links fail. Google Drive share links are resolved to their download URL. A URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage is used as it is and not checked again.

Per-network overrides: A `<prefix>_message` equal to `message` is not treated as a customisation. On a text post a different per-network message gets its own link preview from the first link in that text. Covers, post types and first comments mark a tab as customised only when they apply (a cover on a network without a video is dropped silently). A blank per-network field counts as not sent.

Pinterest destination: When any chosen account is Pinterest, on an image, video or mixed post, `url` (or the first link in the text) is saved as the pin's destination link, with `http://` added when the scheme is missing. A value that is not a URL answers 400 `Invalid url parameter supplied.`

Instagram extras: Location, image tags, reel tags, collaborators, music, the trial flag and product tags are saved only on the Instagram tab. `in_image_tags` and `in_product_tags` positions refer to `in_image_url` when Instagram has its own images, else to `image_url`, and are stored against the hosted copy of that image. Usernames are stored without the leading `@` and de-duplicated. Music (`in_audio_*`), `in_trial_reel` and `in_reel_product_tags` need `in_post_type=reel` and answer 400 on a feed or story post; music needs an account connected through Facebook login, see `/api/instagram_audio_search`.

Facebook page mentions: `fb_mentions` lists the pages; the text has to carry `@<page id>` where each mention goes, as `/api/mention_search` returns the id. With a `name` the stored text reads `@<name>` and the publisher turns each one into Facebook's mention when it posts to a Page.

Google Business button: `gbp_cta=None` clears the button and both links. An `Offer` button with `gbp_cta_url` and no `gbp_redeem_offer_link` uses the button link as the redeem link. A link post with no button gets `Learn more` pointing at the link automatically. The button is saved for every caller, also for key-in-body calls (the Zapier-era endpoint used to drop it).

Twitter/X thread: `twitter_thread` items become follow-up tweets under the main tweet. Each item's media is hosted the same way as the main post's; a thread item with a video needs the same paid plan as `video_url`. The thread is ignored by every other network.

YouTube and TikTok options need a privacy status: The YouTube options and the TikTok options are stored together with a privacy status. Send `yt_privacy_status` / `tk_privacy_status`, or one of the newer options (licence, embedding, languages, recording date, playlists, AI label for YouTube; auto music, cover, cover frame, AI label for TikTok), which default it to public. With only the older options and no privacy status nothing is stored for that network and its defaults apply, as on the Zapier-era endpoint.

Plan rules follow the workspace owner: Video uploads, the one-off post limit and media storage are checked against the workspace owner's plan, not the caller's, when a team member posts into someone else's workspace.

Per-network media: A network can post media of its own: `<prefix>_image_url` and `<prefix>_video_url` (`fb_`, `tw_`, `ln_`, `in_`, `gmb_`, `pi_`, `yt_`, `tk_`, `th_`, `bs_`) replace the shared media on that network only and mark its tab as customised. Each network keeps its own cap (Facebook 15, Twitter/X 4, LinkedIn 20, Instagram 10 in all, Google Business 1, Pinterest 1, TikTok 10, Threads 20 in all, Bluesky 4); only Instagram and Threads combine images with a video, ordered by `in_media_order` / `th_media_order`; YouTube takes `yt_video_url` only. A URL named by several fields is downloaded once. Covers (`fb_thumb` and the others) apply to whichever video that network ends up with. A blank per-network media field counts as not sent, so that network keeps the shared media.

AI disclosure labels: Each network has the same switch as the composer's network tab: `fb_is_ai_generated` and `fb_ai_images` (Facebook), `tw_made_with_ai` (Twitter/X), `in_is_ai_generated` (Instagram), `pi_ai_modified` and `pi_synthetic_performer` (Pinterest), `yt_contains_synthetic_media` (YouTube) and `tk_is_aigc` (TikTok). Only `1` or `true` switches a label on, and a label marks that network's tab as customised. LinkedIn, Google Business, Threads and Bluesky have no label.

Key-in-body calls: Called with `emailid` and `api_key` in the body (the Zapier-era form), every error comes back as HTTP 200 with `status`, `error` and `code` in the body, and `image_url` together with `video_url` keeps the video only. Bearer and Basic callers get real HTTP statuses and a mixed post.

Legacy endpoint: with body credentials errors arrive as HTTP 200 with the real status in the body field `status`. With a Bearer token or a Basic header it returns real HTTP status codes.

id.description: Encrypted social account ids from `/api/social_account_list`: an array, a JSON array string, a comma-separated string or one id. At most 50. Every account must sit in the workspace; the same post goes to all of them.

message.description: Post text for every network. Always required, also on media posts. `\r\n` is normalised to `\n`. Links in it are detected for the link preview and, on Pinterest, for the pin's destination.
message.example: Check out our summer sale! https://example.com/summer-sale

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from `/api/workspace_list`.

schedule_date_time.description: When to publish; leave out to publish now. A value with an offset or `Z` (`2026-10-20T09:30:00+05:30`) is one exact moment, converted to each account's timezone. A bare `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (also with `T`, seconds optional) is wall-clock time in each account's own timezone (the workspace owner's for an account without one), so accounts in different zones publish at the same local time. Must be in the future for every account. The misspelt legacy name `shedule_date_time` is still accepted. The date must be a real calendar day and the time a real clock time: a value such as `2026-13-40 10:00:00`, `2027-02-30 10:00:00` or `25:00` is refused with 400, never rolled over into another day.

url.description: Link to share with the post. On a text post the page's title, description and image are fetched and saved as the link preview; when omitted, the first link found in `message` is used instead. When a Pinterest account is targeted, on an image or video post, it becomes the pin's destination link. `http://` is prepended when the scheme is missing. The host must be a public address.

image_url.description: Image URLs in display order: an array, a JSON array string, or one URL string (repeat `image_url[]` in form encoding). At most 20. Each must be a public http or https URL; it is downloaded and stored in the workspace owner's RecurPost media storage unless `host_images_on_recurpost` is off. A URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage (for example from `/api/media_list`) is used as it is, without a download. Together with `video_url` it makes a mixed post (images and the video in one carousel on Instagram and Threads; every other network posts what it takes by default). Exception: a key-in-body (Zapier-era) call that sends both keeps the video only, as that endpoint always did; Bearer and Basic callers get the mixed post.

video_url.description: A public mp4 or mov URL (Google Drive share links are resolved to the download URL). The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage during the call, whatever `host_images_on_recurpost` says; a URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage skips the download. Needs a paid plan of the workspace owner. A URL that answers 404 or 410 is refused with 422 `media_failed` (could not be downloaded), not as a wrong format.

media_order.description: The order of a mixed post's media as a list of the original URLs given in `image_url` and `video_url`. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both images and a video are sent. Any URL not in `image_url` / `video_url` answers 400.

host_images_on_recurpost.description: Copy images and custom covers (`fb_thumb` and the others) to RecurPost storage, the default. `false`, `0`, `no` or `off` keeps your own image URLs instead: they are only checked to be public and must stay reachable until every post using them has been published. Videos and the LinkedIn document are always stored.

alt_text.description: Alternative text per shared image, in `image_url` order: an array, a JSON array string, or one string for the first image. At most 1000 characters each; blank entries are skipped. Saved on the Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky tabs that post the shared images; Instagram, Google Business, YouTube and TikTok take no alt text.

first_comment.description: First comment posted right after the post, commonly hashtags. Used on Facebook, LinkedIn and Instagram unless that network's own first comment is given.

fb_message.description: Text for Facebook accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

tw_message.description: Text for Twitter/X accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

ln_message.description: Text for LinkedIn accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

in_message.description: Text for Instagram accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

gmb_message.description: Text for Google Business accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

pi_message.description: Text for Pinterest accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

yt_message.description: Text for YouTube accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. On YouTube this is the video description.

tk_message.description: Text for TikTok accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

th_message.description: Text for Threads accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

bs_message.description: Text for Bluesky accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

fb_image_url.description: Images for Facebook accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 15 images on Facebook. Cannot be combined with `fb_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

fb_video_url.description: A video for Facebook accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `fb_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

fb_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `fb_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

tw_image_url.description: Images for Twitter/X accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 4 images on Twitter/X. Cannot be combined with `tw_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

tw_video_url.description: A video for Twitter/X accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `tw_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

tw_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `tw_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

ln_image_url.description: Images for LinkedIn accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 20 images on LinkedIn. Cannot be combined with `ln_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

ln_video_url.description: A video for LinkedIn accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `ln_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

ln_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `ln_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

in_image_url.description: Images for Instagram accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 10 media in all, images and video together on Instagram. May be combined with `in_video_url` into a carousel; `in_media_order` sets the order. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

in_video_url.description: A video for Instagram accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with `in_image_url` into a carousel. A blank value counts as not sent.

in_media_order.description: The order of Instagram's own media as a list of the URLs given in `in_image_url` and `in_video_url`. Media left out follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

gmb_image_url.description: Images for Google Business accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 1 image on Google Business. Cannot be combined with `gmb_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

gmb_video_url.description: A video for Google Business accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `gmb_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

pi_image_url.description: Images for Pinterest accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 1 image on Pinterest. Cannot be combined with `pi_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

pi_video_url.description: A video for Pinterest accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `pi_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

pi_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `pi_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

yt_video_url.description: A video for YouTube accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. YouTube takes a video only; `yt_image_url` answers 400. A blank value counts as not sent.

tk_image_url.description: Images for TikTok accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 10 images on TikTok. Cannot be combined with `tk_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

tk_video_url.description: A video for TikTok accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `tk_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

th_image_url.description: Images for Threads accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 20 media in all, images and video together on Threads. May be combined with `th_video_url` into a carousel; `th_media_order` sets the order. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

th_video_url.description: A video for Threads accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with `th_image_url` into a carousel. A blank value counts as not sent.

th_media_order.description: The order of Threads's own media as a list of the URLs given in `th_image_url` and `th_video_url`. Media left out follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

th_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `th_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

bs_image_url.description: Images for Bluesky accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 4 images on Bluesky. Cannot be combined with `bs_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

bs_video_url.description: A video for Bluesky accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `bs_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

bs_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `bs_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

fb_post_type.description: Facebook post type, case-insensitive: one of the listed values, or a list (an array or JSON array string) to post several types at once, as the composer does: `["feed", "story"]`, `["feed", "reel"]`, `["story", "reel"]` or `["feed", "story", "reel"]`. Each type becomes its own queue item on every Facebook page of the post (one row per type in `post_status`). An unknown value answers 400; a one-item list is the same as the single value.

fb_thumb.description: Custom cover image for Facebook's video. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless `host_images_on_recurpost` is off. Ignored when Facebook posts no video.

fb_first_comment.description: Facebook first comment; overrides `first_comment` on Facebook.

fb_mentions.description: Facebook pages to mention, up to 10: page ids from `/api/mention_search`, as an array (or JSON array string, or comma-separated string) of ids or of objects with `page_id` and `name`. Write `@<page id>` in the text where each mention goes; with a `name` the stored text reads `@<name>`, the way the composer writes a picked mention. Saved as page mentions on the Facebook tab. An id that is not all digits answers 400.

fb_background_id.description: Facebook text background, from `/api/facebook_backgrounds` (letters, digits, underscore or dash, up to 64 characters). Only on a post whose Facebook tab has no images and no video; otherwise 400.

fb_is_ai_generated.description: Label the Facebook post as made with AI. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on. On a reel Facebook shows its AI label; on an image post every image on the Facebook tab is labelled. Use `fb_ai_images` to label only some images or to give the provenance type.

fb_ai_images.description: Images to label as AI-generated photos on Facebook, named by the original URLs given in `image_url` (or `fb_image_url` when Facebook has its own images): an array of URL strings, or of objects with `image_url` and `provenance_type`. `provenance_type` defaults to `EXPLICIT` and takes any type Facebook's photo API knows, for example `EXPLICIT`, `EXPLICIT_AI_EDIT`, `C2PA`, `IPTC`, `INVISIBLE_WATERMARK` or `NONE` (case-insensitive). A URL that is not one of the post's Facebook images, or an unknown type, answers 400.

tw_made_with_ai.description: Label the post as made with AI on Twitter/X. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on.

twitter_thread.description: Follow-up tweets posted as a thread under the main tweet on Twitter/X accounts: an array (or JSON array string) of objects, each with `message` and optionally `image_url` (up to 4) or `video_url` (one, not both). At most 25 items; each needs a message, an image or a video. Media is hosted like the main post's and a thread video needs the paid plan too. Each item counts as a post in the owner's daily limit when an X account is targeted. Other networks ignore it.

ln_document.description: Public URL of a document for a LinkedIn document (carousel) post: PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX, detected from the file itself, not its name; any other type answers 415. The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage and the LinkedIn tab becomes a document post. Google Drive share links are resolved.

ln_document_title.description: Title shown on the LinkedIn document. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

ln_thumb.description: Custom cover image for LinkedIn's video, hosted like `fb_thumb`. Ignored when LinkedIn posts no video.

ln_first_comment.description: LinkedIn first comment; overrides `first_comment` on LinkedIn.

in_post_type.description: Instagram post type, case-insensitive: one of the listed values, or the list `["feed", "story"]` or `["story", "reel"]` to post both, as the composer does (each type becomes its own queue item; the second goes out a minute after the first). Instagram does not take a reel together with a feed post, so `["feed", "reel"]` answers 400, as does an unknown value. A reel needs a video; the reel options (`in_thumb`, `in_reel_share_in_feed`, `in_trial_reel`, `in_audio_id`, reel tags and products) apply whenever `reel` is one of the types.

in_reel_share_in_feed.description: Whether a reel also appears in the profile feed. Only `no` switches it off; read on reels only.

in_thumb.description: Custom cover image for an Instagram reel, hosted like `fb_thumb`. Only applied when `in_post_type` is or includes `reel` and Instagram posts a video.

in_first_comment.description: Instagram first comment; overrides `first_comment` on Instagram.

in_location_id.description: Instagram place id to tag the post with (letters, digits or underscore, up to 64 characters). Take `id` and `name` from `/api/instagram_locations`; `in_location_name` is required with it.

in_location_name.description: Name of the place in `in_location_id`, required with it.

in_location_city.description: City of the tagged place, as returned by `/api/instagram_locations`.

in_location_country.description: Country of the tagged place, as returned by `/api/instagram_locations`.

in_image_tags.description: People to tag on images: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with `username` (leading `@` optional), `x` and `y` (fractions of the image width and height, 0 to 1) and `image` (1-based position in Instagram's images, default 1). A malformed entry or one pointing past the last image answers 400.

in_reel_tags.description: Usernames to tag on a reel, as an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated string. Needs a video on Instagram's tab; answers 400 without one.

in_collaborators.description: Instagram usernames invited as collaborators, as an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated string. At most 3; more answer 400.

in_audio_id.description: Music for an Instagram reel: a track id from `/api/instagram_audio_search`. Needs `in_post_type` `reel`, a video and `in_audio_account_id`; sent on any other post it answers 400.

in_audio_account_id.description: Encrypted id of the Instagram account the audio search ran for, from `/api/social_account_list`. Required with `in_audio_id`; must be an Instagram account of this workspace (404 otherwise).

in_audio_type.description: Kind of track, as the search returned it.

in_audio_title.description: Track title from the search, stored for display.

in_audio_artist.description: Artist from the search, stored for display.

in_audio_duration_ms.description: Track length in milliseconds from the search, a whole number; 0 when omitted.

in_audio_volume.description: Volume of the added track, 0 to 100.

in_video_volume.description: Volume of the video's own sound under the track, 0 to 100; 0 mutes it.

in_trial_reel.description: Publish the reel as an Instagram trial reel (shown to non-followers first): `manual` leaves sharing to everyone up to you, `performance` lets Instagram share it when it does well. Reels only; on another post type, or with another value, it answers 400.

in_product_tags.description: Shopping tags on images: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with `account_id` (encrypted Instagram account of this workspace), `product_id` (from `/api/instagram_products`), `image` (1-based position in Instagram's images, default 1), `x` and `y` (0 to 1, default 0.5) and optional `product_name` and `product_image` for display.

in_reel_product_tags.description: Shopping tags on a reel: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with `account_id` (encrypted Instagram account of this workspace), `product_id` (from `/api/instagram_products`) and optional `product_name` and `image_url` for display. Needs `in_post_type` `reel`; on another post type it answers 400.

in_is_ai_generated.description: Label the Instagram post as AI-generated. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on.

pi_title.description: Pin title. The destination link of the pin is `url` or the first link in the text.
pi_title.example: Summer Sale - Best Deals of the Season

pi_ai_modified.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: the Pin's content was generated or modified with AI. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on.

pi_synthetic_performer.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: a person shown or heard in the Pin is AI-generated. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on.

gbp_cta.description: Call-to-action button on the Google Business post. Case-insensitive. An unknown value or `None` saves no button. On a link post with no button given, `Learn more` pointing at the link is set automatically.

gbp_cta_url.description: Link the button opens. With `gbp_cta=Offer` and no `gbp_redeem_offer_link`, this value doubles as the redeem link.

gbp_offer_title.description: Offer title; the offer fields are used when `gbp_cta` is `Offer`.

gbp_offer_start_date.description: Offer start, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Stored as sent without a check; a value that is not a date makes the offer fail on Google.

gbp_offer_end_date.description: Offer end, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`, after the start. Stored as sent without a check.

gbp_offer_coupon_code.description: Coupon code shown on the offer.

gbp_offer_terms.description: Terms and conditions of the offer.

yt_title.description: Video title. YouTube needs a video; `message` or `yt_message` is the description.

yt_category.description: Category name, matched exactly against the list. An unknown or missing name falls back to the default category of the workspace owner's YouTube settings.

yt_privacy_status.description: Video privacy, one of the listed values (case-insensitive); any other value answers 400. The YouTube options (category, tags, thumbnail, made for kids, licence, embedding, languages, recording date, AI label) are saved together with a privacy status: left out, it defaults to `public` when one of `yt_license`, `yt_embeddable`, `yt_default_language`, `yt_default_audio_language`, `yt_recording_date`, `yt_contains_synthetic_media=1` or `yt_playlists` is sent; with only the older options (`yt_category`, `yt_user_tags`, `yt_thumb`, `yt_video_made_for_kids`) and no privacy status, no options are stored and YouTube's defaults apply, as on the Zapier-era endpoint.

yt_thumb.description: Custom thumbnail for the YouTube video, hosted like `fb_thumb`. Ignored when YouTube posts no video.

yt_video_made_for_kids.description: Whether the video is made for kids. Only `yes` switches it on.

yt_license.description: Video licence. Any other value answers 400.

yt_embeddable.description: Whether other sites may embed the video. `0`, `no` or `false` switches it off.

yt_default_language.description: Language of the title and description, a BCP-47 code such as `en` or `hi`. Stored as sent.

yt_default_audio_language.description: Language spoken in the video, a BCP-47 code. Stored as sent.

yt_recording_date.description: Date the video was recorded, `YYYY-MM-DD`; another form answers 400.

yt_contains_synthetic_media.description: Tell viewers the video contains realistic content altered or generated with AI. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on.

yt_playlists.description: Playlists to add the video to, one per YouTube account: an object (or JSON object string) of encrypted YouTube account id (one of the accounts in `id`) to playlist id (from `/api/youtube_options`). Playlist ids are YouTube's own. Only `/api/post_content` takes it.

tk_privacy_status.description: Who can watch the TikTok video. Case-insensitive, spaces or underscores (`Public to Everyone` or `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE`); any other value answers 400 naming the allowed values (nothing is saved as Public in its place). The TikTok options are saved together with a privacy status: left out, it defaults to `Public to Everyone` when `tk_auto_add_music`, `tk_thumb`, `tk_thumb_timestamp` or `tk_is_aigc=1` is sent; with only the older switches and no privacy status, no options are stored, as on the Zapier-era endpoint. `/api/tiktok_options` lists what the account allows.

tk_allow_comments.description: Allow comments on the TikTok video. Only `no` switches it off.

tk_allow_duet.description: Allow duets. Only `no` switches it off.

tk_allow_stitches.description: Allow stitches. Only `no` switches it off.

tk_promote_own_brand.description: `1` marks the video as promoting your own brand (TikTok's content disclosure).

tk_promote_other_brand.description: `1` marks the video as branded content for a third party.

tk_auto_add_music.description: `1` lets TikTok add music to a photo post.

tk_thumb.description: Custom cover image for TikTok's video, hosted like `fb_thumb`. Ignored when TikTok posts no video.

tk_thumb_timestamp.description: Frame of the video to use as cover, in milliseconds from the start; a whole number, otherwise 400.

tk_is_aigc.description: Add TikTok's AI-generated content label to the video. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on.

bs_thumb.description: Custom cover image for Bluesky's video, hosted like `fb_thumb`. Ignored when Bluesky posts no video.

example.message: Check out our summer sale! https://example.com/summer-sale

id.description: Encrypted post id; poll it with `/api/post_status` or read it with `/api/post_details`. The same value is `post_id` in the queue endpoints and `id` in `/api/history_list`.

account_count.description: Number of social accounts the post was created for.

400.description:
invalid_id: workspace_id is not a valid id. Get ids from /api/workspace_list. (workspace_id was sent but is not a valid encrypted id.)

missing_param: id is required. (id was not sent or is blank.)

invalid_id: id holds a value that is not a valid id. (One of the values in id is not a valid encrypted id.)

invalid_param: id takes at most 50 ids per call; <n> were sent. (More than 50 ids in id.)

missing_param: message is required. (message missing or blank.)

invalid_param: schedule_date_time is not a valid date and time. Send a datetime like 2026-10-20T09:30:00+05:30, or 2026-10-20 09:30:00 in the account's timezone. (schedule_date_time does not parse, or names a day or time that does not exist (month 13, February 30, hour 25, an offset beyond 14 hours).)

schedule_in_past: Oops! You need to schedule your update for a time in the future! (schedule_date_time is now or earlier for at least one account.)

invalid_param: yt_playlists must be an object of YouTube account id to playlist id. (yt_playlists is not an object.)

invalid_param: yt_playlists keys must be YouTube accounts of this post (from id). (A key is not the encrypted id of a YouTube account listed in id.)

invalid_param: yt_playlists values must be playlist ids from /api/youtube_options. (A value is blank or not a string.)

invalid_param: image_url takes at most 20 images. (More than 20 image URLs.)

invalid_param: media_order may only hold the URLs given in image_url and video_url. (media_order names a URL that is not in the post.)

invalid_param: yt_image_url is not accepted; YouTube takes yt_video_url only. (Images sent for YouTube.)

invalid_param: <prefix>_image_url and <prefix>_video_url cannot be combined; only Instagram and Threads take images and a video together. (Images and a video for one network other than Instagram or Threads.)

invalid_param: <prefix>_image_url takes at most <n> images for <network>. (More images than that network takes (Facebook 15, Twitter/X 4, LinkedIn 20, Google Business 1, Pinterest 1, TikTok 10, Bluesky 4).)

invalid_param: <prefix>_image_url and <prefix>_video_url take at most <n> media items together for <network>. (Instagram (10) or Threads (20) got more images and video together.)

invalid_param: <prefix>_media_order may only hold the URLs given in <prefix>_image_url and <prefix>_video_url. (A per-network order names a URL outside that network's own media.)

invalid_param: alt_text entries may have at most 1000 characters. (An `alt_text` entry (or a `<prefix>_alt_text` entry, named in the message) is longer than 1000 characters.)

invalid_param: fb_mentions takes at most 10 pages. (More than 10 mentions.)

invalid_param: fb_mentions holds page ids from mention_search, as a list or as {page_id, name} items. (An fb_mentions entry is not an all-digit page id.)

invalid_param: fb_background_id takes a background id from facebook_backgrounds, on a post without image_url or video_url. (fb_background_id is not a plain id, or the Facebook tab has images or a video.)

invalid_param: fb_post_type takes feed, reel or story, or a list of them such as ["feed", "story"]; "<value>" is not one of them. (fb_post_type (or in_post_type, named in the message, with its own allowed forms) holds an unknown type or is not a string or list.)

invalid_param: in_post_type takes feed, story or reel, or the list ["feed", "story"] or ["story", "reel"]; Instagram cannot post a reel and a feed post together. (in_post_type lists reel together with feed.)

invalid_param: fb_ai_images takes URLs of the post's Facebook images (image_url) with a provenance_type such as EXPLICIT, EXPLICIT_AI_EDIT, C2PA, IPTC or INVISIBLE_WATERMARK. (An fb_ai_images URL is not one of Facebook's images, or the provenance type is unknown. Names `fb_image_url` when Facebook has its own images.)

invalid_param: in_location_name is required with in_location_id; both come from instagram_locations. (in_location_id without in_location_name, or an in_location_id that is not a plain id.)

invalid_param: in_image_tags entries need username, x and y between 0 and 1, and image as a position in image_url. (An in_image_tags entry is malformed or points past the last image. Names `in_image_url` when Instagram has its own images.)

invalid_param: in_reel_tags needs a video_url. (in_reel_tags sent while Instagram posts no video.)

invalid_param: in_collaborators takes at most 3 usernames. (More than 3 collaborators.)

invalid_param: in_audio_id needs in_post_type reel with a video_url, in_audio_account_id (the account instagram_audio_search ran for), in_audio_type music or original_sound, and volumes from 0 to 100. (in_audio_id sent off a reel, without a video, without a valid in_audio_account_id, with an unknown in_audio_type, a volume outside 0 to 100 or a duration that is not a whole number.)

invalid_param: in_trial_reel is manual or performance, on in_post_type reel only. (in_trial_reel sent off a reel or with another value.)

invalid_param: in_product_tags entries need account_id, product_id (from instagram_products), image as a position in image_url, and x and y between 0 and 1. (An in_product_tags entry is malformed, points past the last image, or has coordinates outside 0 to 1.)

invalid_param: in_reel_product_tags entries need account_id and product_id, on in_post_type reel only. (An in_reel_product_tags entry is malformed, or the post is not a reel.)

invalid_id: in_product_tags.account_id is not a valid id. (An account_id in in_product_tags (or in_reel_product_tags, named in the message) is not a valid encrypted id.)

invalid_param: twitter_thread takes at most 25 further tweets. (More than 25 thread items.)

invalid_param: twitter_thread item <n> needs a message, image_url or video_url. (A thread item is empty or not an object.)

invalid_param: twitter_thread item <n> may carry up to 4 images or one video, not both. (A thread item has more than 4 images, or images and a video.)

invalid_param: yt_license must be youtube or creativeCommon. (yt_license has another value.)

invalid_param: yt_recording_date must be a date like 2026-10-20. (yt_recording_date is not YYYY-MM-DD.)

invalid_param: yt_privacy_status must be one of: public, private, unlisted. (yt_privacy_status has another value.)

invalid_param: tk_thumb_timestamp must be a whole number of milliseconds. (tk_thumb_timestamp is not a whole number.)

invalid_param: tk_privacy_status must be one of: Public to Everyone, Mutual Follow Friends, Self Only (or PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, SELF_ONLY). (tk_privacy_status has another value, for example private.)

invalid_url: <param> is not allowed: <url>. Send a publicly reachable http or https URL. (A media, cover, document or link URL is not http or https, or its host resolves to a private, loopback or reserved address (also after a redirect). Ends with `The host could not be resolved.` when the host has no address.)

invalid_url: <param> redirects too many times: <url>. (A media URL redirects more than 5 times.)

invalid_url: Invalid url parameter supplied. (`url` (or the first link in the text, used as preview or Pinterest destination) is not a URL.)

content_rejected: <the app's reason, e.g. You Must upload Image / Video for Posting on Instagram.> (The app's own content check refuses the post for one of the accounts: Instagram and Pinterest need an image or a video, YouTube a video, Facebook pages, X, LinkedIn, Google Business, Threads and Bluesky a message.)

content_rejected: You must add a video or at least one image for Posting on TikTok. (A TikTok account is targeted and the TikTok tab has no video and no image (a text or link post).)

schedule_in_past: <the app's message> (The app refused a time that has passed.)

401.description: Authentication failed: token_required, token_invalid, token_expired, credentials_required or invalid_credentials.

403.description:
permission_denied: Your role in this workspace does not allow this action (Publish or schedule). (Your role lacks `publish`. The body also carries `permission`: `publish`.)

plan_limit: <the app's limit message> (The workspace owner's one-off post limit refuses the post, for example `You have reached your post limit for the selected date. ... to schedule more posts.` or the free-trial post cap. Twitter/X thread items count too.)

plan_restriction: You are not allowed to upload video file in your current plan. Please upgrade your RecurPost plan. (A video (shared, per network or in a thread) while the workspace owner is on a free plan.)

plan_limit: <the app's limit message> (The save hit a plan limit of the workspace owner.)

404.description:
workspace_not_found: Workspace not found or you do not have access to it. (The workspace does not exist, or you are not its owner or an active member.)

not_found: Social account not found in this workspace (id). (An id in id does not belong to the workspace owner or sits outside this workspace.)

not_found: Instagram account not found in this workspace (<field>). (in_audio_account_id or a product tag's account_id is not an Instagram account of this workspace; the field is named in the message.)

415.description:
unsupported_media: <param> is not an image (detected content type: <type>). Send an image URL. (An image or cover URL serves another content type. `<param> did not return a recognizable image.` when it could not be read as an image.)

unsupported_media: <param> is not a video (detected content type: <type>). Send an mp4 or mov URL. (A video URL serves another content type.)

unsupported_media: Invalid video format (detected: <type>). Supported formats: mp4, mov. (The video is neither mp4 nor mov by extension or content type. For another field than video_url the message reads `Invalid video format in <param> ...`.)

unsupported_media: ln_document must be a PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX file (detected: <type>). (The LinkedIn document is of another type.)

422.description:
media_failed: The media URL could not be downloaded: <url> (<param> answered HTTP 404). (An image, video, cover or document URL answers 404 or 410 (the file is not there), or a video or document could not be read. The part in brackets is only present when the server gave that status.)

media_failed: Failed to upload <param>. The URL was reachable but the file could not be processed. (The downloaded file could not be stored.)

content_rejected: Content validation failed! (The app's content validator refused one or more network tabs (text too long, media the network does not take, a reel without a video, ...). The body carries `error_details`, an object keyed by network with the reason.)

429.description: Per-minute rate limit reached; see Retry-After.

500.description: internal_error: Something went wrong. Please try again later. (The app did not answer. A refusal the app explains is relayed with its own text instead (400 request_failed, 404 not_found or 409 conflict).)

post.summary: The images, GIFs and videos already used in the workspace owner's posts, one page at a time.
post.description:
Permission: any active member of the workspace.
Pages through the media the workspace owner has already used in posts, the same list as the composer's media picker. `types` narrows to images, GIFs or videos and `search` matches the text of the posts the media was used in. Every item carries a URL you can send again as `image_url` or `video_url` in `/api/post_content` or `/api/add_content_in_library`; media already on RecurPost storage is not downloaded again.
The app lists the owner's media across all of their workspaces, so `workspace_id` only picks the owner here. Items come in the app's order, which is not strictly newest first. Only public media URLs are returned: an item whose URL is a signed upload or download link (Azure SAS, S3 presigned) is left out, and a signed thumbnail is replaced by an empty string.

No total: The list has no total count. Keep asking for the next page until one comes back empty; a page can hold fewer than `per_page` items before the end because signed links are left out.

types.description: Kinds to list: any of `image`, `gif`, `video`, in any case, as an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated string. All three when omitted.

search.description: Text to match against the posts the media was used in, up to 200 characters. The app does not apply it to every media source, so some items that do not match can still come back.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from `/api/workspace_list`.

url.description: The public media URL.

post.summary: List the drafts of a workspace with the accounts each one targets.
post.description:
Permission: any active member of the workspace.
Returns every draft of the workspace, earliest planned time first, with the social accounts it is saved for. `account_ids` narrows the list to drafts saved for at least one of those accounts; each draft still lists all of its accounts. The whole list is read and then paged, so `total_drafts` is the count of the full list.

Two clocks: The draft-level `planned_for` is the earliest of its accounts' times, shown in the workspace owner's timezone; each account's `planned_for` is in that account's timezone. A draft saved for accounts in different zones shows different wall-clock values that stand for the same instant.

Workspaces that show members only their own posts: When the workspace has show own posts on, a member who is not the owner sees only the one-off posts they created; posts that came from a library stay visible to everyone. Other members' one-off posts answer as if they did not exist (404).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from `/api/workspace_list`.

account_ids.description: Encrypted social account ids from `/api/social_account_list`: an array, a JSON array string, a comma-separated string or one id. At most 50. Only drafts saved for one of these accounts are returned.

total_drafts.description: Number of drafts in the workspace after the `account_ids` filter, across all pages.

id.description: Encrypted draft id, the post id of the draft. Pass it as `draft_id` to `/api/draft_save`, `/api/draft_schedule` and `/api/draft_delete`; it is the same id `/api/post_status` reads.

title.description: Link preview title, blank when the draft has no link.

url.description: Link attached to the draft.

image_url.description: First image, the link preview image, or the video thumbnail; blank for a text draft.

video_url.description: Hosted video URL, blank when there is none.

library.description: Name of the library the draft came from, empty for a one-off draft.

planned_for.description: Earliest intended time of the draft's accounts, in the workspace owner's timezone. When no time was given on saving, this is when the draft was saved.
Intended time in that account's own timezone (the owner's when the account has none).

drafts.message: Our autumn collection drops next week.

400.description:
invalid_id: workspace_id is not a valid id. Get ids from /api/workspace_list. (workspace_id was sent but is not a valid encrypted id.)

invalid_id: account_ids holds a value that is not a valid id. (One of the values in account_ids is not a valid encrypted id.)

invalid_param: account_ids takes at most 50 ids per call; <n> were sent. (More than 50 ids in account_ids.)

invalid_param: page must be a whole number of at least 1. (page is not a positive whole number.)

invalid_param: per_page must be a whole number of at least 1. (per_page is not a positive whole number.)

invalid_param: per_page may be at most 50. (per_page is over 50.)

401.description: Authentication failed: token_required, token_invalid, token_expired, credentials_required or invalid_credentials.

404.description:
workspace_not_found: Workspace not found or you do not have access to it. (The workspace does not exist, or you are not its owner or an active member.)

not_found: Social account not found in this workspace (account_ids). (An id in account_ids does not belong to the workspace owner or sits outside this workspace.)

500.description: internal_error: Something went wrong. Please try again later. (The drafts could not be read. A refusal the app explains is relayed with its own text.)

post.summary: Save a new draft, or replace the content and accounts of an existing one.
post.description:
Permission: Write and edit their posts (`create-posts`) or Publish or schedule (`publish`). Replacing a draft also needs the right to edit that post: the owner, Edit others' post (`edit-others`), `publish`, or `create-posts` on a draft you created.
Saves a post as a draft for one or several social accounts. Takes the content fields of `/api/post_content`: the text, media, link, the per-network text and media and the network options listed below (all but `yt_playlists`). Media URLs are downloaded and copied to RecurPost storage during the call, so expect it to take a few seconds for videos.
Send `draft_id` to replace an existing draft in place: its text, media, options and account list are overwritten with what you send; its labels stay. Only a post that is still a draft can be replaced; any other post answers 409.
The content is validated per network before anything is written. A failure answers 422 with `error_details` keyed by network and nothing is saved.

Replacing is a full overwrite: With `draft_id` the draft's text, media, per-network options and account list are all replaced by the request. Fields you leave out are cleared, not kept. The id and the labels stay. To change a single field, read the draft with `/api/post_details` and send it back with your change.

Media is fetched during the call: Images, videos, covers and LinkedIn documents are downloaded and copied to RecurPost storage while the request runs. A URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage (for example from `/api/media_list`) is used as it is.

Same fields as post_content: Every content field, its rules and its errors are those of `/api/post_content`, with two differences: `message` may be left out when `image_url` or `video_url` is sent, and `yt_playlists` is not taken. `image_url` with `video_url` always makes a mixed post here.

Per-network media: A network can post media of its own: `<prefix>_image_url` and `<prefix>_video_url` replace the shared media on that network only. Each network keeps its own cap (Facebook 15, Twitter/X 4, LinkedIn 20, Instagram 10 in all, Google Business 1, Pinterest 1, TikTok 10, Threads 20 in all, Bluesky 4); only Instagram and Threads combine images with a video; YouTube takes `yt_video_url` only. A blank per-network media field counts as not sent.

id.description: Encrypted social account ids from `/api/social_account_list`: an array, a JSON array string, a comma-separated string or one id. At most 50, all in the workspace.

message.description: Post text for every network. Required unless `image_url` or `video_url` is sent. `\r\n` is normalised to `\n`. Links in it are detected for the link preview and, on Pinterest, for the pin's destination.
message.example: Check out our summer sale! https://example.com/summer-sale

draft_id.description: Encrypted id of an existing draft (from `/api/draft_list` or an earlier `/api/draft_save`). When sent, that draft is replaced in place instead of a new one being created.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from `/api/workspace_list`.

schedule_date_time.description: Intended publish time, recorded on the draft only; the post is not scheduled until `/api/draft_schedule`. A bare `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (also with `T`, seconds optional) is wall-clock time in each account's timezone; a value with an offset or `Z` is one moment, converted to each account's timezone. A value that does not parse is ignored and a past time is not refused. When omitted the app records the save time. The misspelt `shedule_date_time` is also read.

url.description: Link to share with the post. On a text post the page's title, description and image are fetched and saved as the link preview; when omitted, the first link found in `message` is used instead. When a Pinterest account is targeted, on an image or video post, it becomes the pin's destination link. `http://` is prepended when the scheme is missing. The host must be a public address.

image_url.description: Image URLs in display order: an array, a JSON array string, or one URL string (repeat `image_url[]` in form encoding). At most 20. Each must be a public http or https URL; it is downloaded and stored in the workspace owner's RecurPost media storage unless `host_images_on_recurpost` is off. A URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage (for example from `/api/media_list`) is used as it is, without a download. Together with `video_url` it makes a mixed post (images and the video in one carousel on Instagram and Threads; every other network posts what it takes by default).

video_url.description: A public mp4 or mov URL (Google Drive share links are resolved to the download URL). The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage during the call, whatever `host_images_on_recurpost` says; a URL already in the owner's RecurPost storage skips the download. Needs a paid plan of the workspace owner.

media_order.description: The order of a mixed post's media as a list of the original URLs given in `image_url` and `video_url`. Media left out of the list follow, video first. Only read when both images and a video are sent. Any URL not in `image_url` / `video_url` answers 400.

host_images_on_recurpost.description: Copy images and custom covers (`fb_thumb` and the others) to RecurPost storage, the default. `false`, `0`, `no` or `off` keeps your own image URLs instead: they are only checked to be public and must stay reachable until every post using them has been published. Videos and the LinkedIn document are always stored.

alt_text.description: Alternative text per shared image, in `image_url` order: an array, a JSON array string, or one string for the first image. At most 1000 characters each; blank entries are skipped. Saved on the Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky tabs that post the shared images; Instagram, Google Business, YouTube and TikTok take no alt text.

first_comment.description: First comment posted right after the post, commonly hashtags. Used on Facebook, LinkedIn and Instagram unless that network's own first comment is given.

fb_message.description: Text for Facebook accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

tw_message.description: Text for Twitter/X accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

ln_message.description: Text for LinkedIn accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

in_message.description: Text for Instagram accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

gmb_message.description: Text for Google Business accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

pi_message.description: Text for Pinterest accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

yt_message.description: Text for YouTube accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview. On YouTube this is the video description.

tk_message.description: Text for TikTok accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

th_message.description: Text for Threads accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

bs_message.description: Text for Bluesky accounts when it should differ from `message`. A value equal to `message` is not a customisation. On a text post the first link in this text becomes that network's link preview.

fb_image_url.description: Images for Facebook accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 15 images on Facebook. Cannot be combined with `fb_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

fb_video_url.description: A video for Facebook accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `fb_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

fb_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `fb_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

tw_image_url.description: Images for Twitter/X accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 4 images on Twitter/X. Cannot be combined with `tw_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

tw_video_url.description: A video for Twitter/X accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `tw_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

tw_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `tw_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

ln_image_url.description: Images for LinkedIn accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 20 images on LinkedIn. Cannot be combined with `ln_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

ln_video_url.description: A video for LinkedIn accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `ln_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

ln_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `ln_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

in_image_url.description: Images for Instagram accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 10 media in all, images and video together on Instagram. May be combined with `in_video_url` into a carousel; `in_media_order` sets the order. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

in_video_url.description: A video for Instagram accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. May be combined with `in_image_url` into a carousel. A blank value counts as not sent.

in_media_order.description: The order of Instagram's own media as a list of the URLs given in `in_image_url` and `in_video_url`. Media left out follow, video first. Only read when both are sent. Any other URL answers 400.

gmb_image_url.description: Images for Google Business accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 1 image on Google Business. Cannot be combined with `gmb_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

gmb_video_url.description: A video for Google Business accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `gmb_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

pi_image_url.description: Images for Pinterest accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 1 image on Pinterest. Cannot be combined with `pi_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

pi_video_url.description: A video for Pinterest accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `pi_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

pi_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `pi_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

yt_video_url.description: A video for YouTube accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. YouTube takes a video only; `yt_image_url` answers 400. A blank value counts as not sent.

tk_image_url.description: Images for TikTok accounts instead of the shared media, same forms, rules and hosting as `image_url`. At most 10 images on TikTok. Cannot be combined with `tk_video_url`. Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

tk_video_url.description: A video for TikTok accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `tk_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

May be combined with `th_video_url` into a carousel; `th_media_order` sets the order. th_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `th_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.

Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised; the other networks keep the shared media. A blank value counts as not sent.

bs_video_url.description: A video for Bluesky accounts instead of the shared media, same rules and hosting as `video_url` (mp4 or mov, paid plan). Replaces that network's whole media set and marks its tab as customised. Cannot be combined with `bs_image_url`. A blank value counts as not sent.

bs_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the `bs_image_url` images, in that order; at most 1000 characters each. The shared `alt_text` is not applied to a network that has its own images.
example: Square crop of the sale banner

fb_post_type.description: Facebook post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps `feed`.

fb_thumb.description: Custom cover image for Facebook's video. Public image URL; copied to RecurPost storage unless `host_images_on_recurpost` is off. Ignored when Facebook posts no video.

fb_first_comment.description: Facebook first comment; overrides `first_comment` on Facebook.

fb_mentions.description: Facebook pages to mention, up to 10: page ids from `/api/mention_search`, as an array (or JSON array string, or comma-separated string) of ids or of objects with `page_id` and `name`. Write `@<page id>` in the text where each mention goes; with a `name` the stored text reads `@<name>`, the way the composer writes a picked mention. Saved as page mentions on the Facebook tab. An id that is not all digits answers 400.

fb_background_id.description: Facebook text background, from `/api/facebook_backgrounds` (letters, digits, underscore or dash, up to 64 characters). Only on a post whose Facebook tab has no images and no video; otherwise 400.

fb_is_ai_generated.description: Label the Facebook post as made with AI. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on. On a reel Facebook shows its AI label; on an image post every image on the Facebook tab is labelled. Use `fb_ai_images` to label only some images or to give the provenance type.

fb_ai_images.description: Images to label as AI-generated photos on Facebook, named by the original URLs given in `image_url` (or `fb_image_url` when Facebook has its own images): an array of URL strings, or of objects with `image_url` and `provenance_type`. `provenance_type` defaults to `EXPLICIT` and takes any type Facebook's photo API knows, for example `EXPLICIT`, `EXPLICIT_AI_EDIT`, `C2PA`, `IPTC`, `INVISIBLE_WATERMARK` or `NONE` (case-insensitive). A URL that is not one of the post's Facebook images, or an unknown type, answers 400.

tw_made_with_ai.description: Label the post as made with AI on Twitter/X. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on.

twitter_thread.description: Follow-up tweets posted as a thread under the main tweet on Twitter/X accounts: an array (or JSON array string) of objects, each with `message` and optionally `image_url` (up to 4) or `video_url` (one, not both). At most 25 items; each needs a message, an image or a video. Media is hosted like the main post's and a thread video needs the paid plan too. Each item counts as a post in the owner's daily limit when an X account is targeted. Other networks ignore it.

ln_document.description: Public URL of a document for a LinkedIn document (carousel) post: PDF, PPT, PPTX, DOC or DOCX, detected from the file itself, not its name; any other type answers 415. The file is downloaded and stored on RecurPost storage and the LinkedIn tab becomes a document post. Google Drive share links are resolved.

ln_document_title.description: Title shown on the LinkedIn document. Defaults to the file name without its extension.

ln_thumb.description: Custom cover image for LinkedIn's video, hosted like `fb_thumb`. Ignored when LinkedIn posts no video.

ln_first_comment.description: LinkedIn first comment; overrides `first_comment` on LinkedIn.

in_post_type.description: Instagram post type. Case-insensitive; an unknown value keeps `feed`. A reel needs a video.

in_reel_share_in_feed.description: Whether a reel also appears in the profile feed. Only `no` switches it off; read on reels only.

in_thumb.description: Custom cover image for an Instagram reel, hosted like `fb_thumb`. Only applied when `in_post_type` is `reel` and Instagram posts a video.

in_first_comment.description: Instagram first comment; overrides `first_comment` on Instagram.

in_location_id.description: Instagram place id to tag the post with (letters, digits or underscore, up to 64 characters). Take `id` and `name` from `/api/instagram_locations`; `in_location_name` is required with it.

in_location_name.description: Name of the place in `in_location_id`, required with it.

in_location_city.description: City of the tagged place, as returned by `/api/instagram_locations`.

in_location_country.description: Country of the tagged place, as returned by `/api/instagram_locations`.

in_image_tags.description: People to tag on images: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with `username` (leading `@` optional), `x` and `y` (fractions of the image width and height, 0 to 1) and `image` (1-based position in Instagram's images, default 1). A malformed entry or one pointing past the last image answers 400.

in_reel_tags.description: Usernames to tag on a reel, as an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated string. Needs a video on Instagram's tab; answers 400 without one.

in_collaborators.description: Instagram usernames invited as collaborators, as an array, a JSON array string or a comma-separated string. At most 3; more answer 400.

in_audio_id.description: Music for an Instagram reel: a track id from `/api/instagram_audio_search`. Needs `in_post_type` `reel`, a video and `in_audio_account_id`; sent on any other post it answers 400.

in_audio_account_id.description: Encrypted id of the Instagram account the audio search ran for, from `/api/social_account_list`. Required with `in_audio_id`; must be an Instagram account of this workspace (404 otherwise).

in_audio_type.description: Kind of track, as the search returned it.

in_audio_title.description: Track title from the search, stored for display.

in_audio_artist.description: Artist from the search, stored for display.

in_audio_duration_ms.description: Track length in milliseconds from the search, a whole number; 0 when omitted.

in_audio_volume.description: Volume of the added track, 0 to 100.

in_video_volume.description: Volume of the video's own sound under the track, 0 to 100; 0 mutes it.

in_trial_reel.description: Publish the reel as an Instagram trial reel (shown to non-followers first): `manual` leaves sharing to everyone up to you, `performance` lets Instagram share it when it does well. Reels only; on another post type, or with another value, it answers 400.

in_product_tags.description: Shopping tags on images: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with `account_id` (encrypted Instagram account of this workspace), `product_id` (from `/api/instagram_products`), `image` (1-based position in Instagram's images, default 1), `x` and `y` (0 to 1, default 0.5) and optional `product_name` and `product_image` for display.

in_reel_product_tags.description: Shopping tags on a reel: an array (or JSON array string) of objects with `account_id` (encrypted Instagram account of this workspace), `product_id` (from `/api/instagram_products`) and optional `product_name` and `image_url` for display. Needs `in_post_type` `reel`; on another post type it answers 400.

in_is_ai_generated.description: Label the Instagram post as AI-generated. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on.

pi_title.description: Pin title. The destination link of the pin is `url` or the first link in the text.
pi_title.example: Summer Sale - Best Deals of the Season

pi_ai_modified.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: the Pin's content was generated or modified with AI. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on.

pi_synthetic_performer.description: Pinterest AI disclosure: a person shown or heard in the Pin is AI-generated. Only `1` (or `true`) switches it on.

gbp_cta.description: Call-to-action button on the Google Business post. Case-insensitive. An unknown value or `None` saves no button. On a link post with no button given, `Learn more` pointing at the link is set automatically.

gbp_cta_url.description: Link the button opens. With `gbp_cta=Offer` and no `gbp_redeem_offer_link`, this value doubles as the redeem link.

gbp_offer_title.description: Offer title; the offer fields are used when `gbp_cta` is `Offer`.

gbp_offer_start_date.description: Offer start, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Stored as sent without a check; a value that is not a date makes the offer fail on Google.

gbp_offer_end_date.description: Offer end, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`, after the start. Stored as sent without a check.

gbp_offer_coupon_code.description: Coupon code shown on the offer.

gbp_offer_terms.description: Terms and conditions of the offer.

yt_title.description: Video title. YouTube needs a video; `message` or `yt_message` is the description.

yt_category.description: Category name, matched exactly against the list. An unknown or missing name falls back to the default category of the workspace owner's YouTube settings.

yt_privacy_status.description: Video privacy, lower-cased and stored as given, so use one of the listed values. The YouTube options (category, tags, thumbnail, made for kids, licence, embedding, languages, recording date, AI label) are saved together with a privacy status: left out, it defaults to `public` when one of `yt_license`, `yt_embeddable`, `yt_default_language`, `yt_default_audio_language`, `yt_recording_date`, `yt_contains_synthetic_media=1` or `yt_playlists` is sent; with only the older options (`yt_category`, `yt_user_tags`, `yt_thumb`, `yt_video_made_for_kids`) and no privacy status, no options are stored and YouTube's defaults apply, as on the Zapier-era endpoint.

yt_thumb.description: Custom thumbnail for the YouTube video, hosted like `fb_thumb`. Ignored when YouTube posts no video.

yt_video_made_for_kids.description: Whether the video is made for kids. Only `yes` switches it on.

yt_license.description: Video licence. Any other value answers 400.

yt_embeddable.description: Whether other sites may embed the video. `0`, `no` or `false` switches it off.

yt_default_language.description: Language of the title and description, a BCP-47 code such as `en` or `hi`. Stored as sent.

yt_default_audio_language.description: Language spoken in the video, a BCP-47 code. Stored as sent.

post.summary: Turn a draft into a scheduled post at the given time, keeping its id.
post.description:
Permission: Publish or schedule (`publish`) in the workspace.
Schedules every account row of the draft at `schedule_date_time`, read the way `/api/post_content` reads it: a bare time is the wall-clock time in each account's own timezone (the workspace owner's for an account without one), so accounts in different zones publish at the same local time; a value with an offset or `Z` (for example `2026-11-03T10:00:00+05:30`) is one moment for every account. Every resulting time must be in the future.
The owner's one-off post limit for that day is checked first, then the stored content is validated again and saved as a scheduled post. The post keeps its id and from then on appears in `/api/queue_list` and `/api/post_status` as scheduled.

Offsets: With an offset or `Z` every account gets the same instant and `scheduled_for` shows it in the workspace owner's timezone. Without one, each account reads the wall clock in its own timezone.

The draft is checked again: The stored content goes through the same checks as a new post, so a draft whose media or options no longer fit (for example a video after a downgrade to a free plan) is refused with the error of `/api/post_content`.

Editing afterwards: Once scheduled, the post is no longer a draft: change it with `/api/queue_post_update` or `/api/queue_reschedule`, not `/api/draft_save`, which answers 409 for it.

schedule_date_time.description: Publish time. `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (also with `T`, seconds optional) is wall-clock time in each account's timezone; a value with an offset or `Z` is one exact moment.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Defaults to your default workspace. Get ids from `/api/workspace_list`.

account_count.description: Number of social accounts the post was scheduled for.

scheduled_for.description: The time applied, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`: the wall-clock time you sent, or with an offset that moment in the workspace owner's timezone.

post.summary: Delete a draft and every account row it holds.
post.description:
Permission: Delete own posts (`delete-own`) for a draft you created, Delete others' posts (`delete-others`) for anyone else's; the owner always.
Removes the draft for all of its social accounts. Each account row is deleted through the app, so the dashboard and the drafts board reflect it at once. The call succeeds when at least one row was removed. No `confirm` is needed.

Workspaces that show members only their own posts: When the workspace has show own posts on, a member who is not the owner sees only the one-off posts they created; posts that came from a library stay visible to everyone. Other members' one-off posts answer as if they did not exist (404).
